thesis: MetrAIyux 0S is a VPS-ready business operating system with FS27 as parent gate, SkyePay as payment unlock lane, CitadelDB as sovereign database option, SkyeVault as file/repo/docs vault, and SkyeMail as business email lane.

lanes.title: SkyeGateFS27
lanes.customer_choice: Parent auth, billing, AI usage, policy, telemetry, and enforcement.

lanes.title: SkyePay
lanes.customer_choice: Stripe-backed transaction lane with automatic unlock after confirmed payment.

lanes.title: CitadelDB
lanes.customer_choice: Use the sovereign database lane instead of Neon when an owner wants full-stack control.

lanes.title: SkyeVault
lanes.customer_choice: Use SkyeVault for customer files, proof exports, documents, repo/package storage, and handoff packs.

lanes.title: SkyeMail
lanes.customer_choice: Use the sovereign business email lane for workspace inboxes, approval-sensitive sends, and mailbox keys.

go_live_rules: Every customer-facing plan must show setup fee, monthly fee, AI cap, RPM, RPD, devices, workspace count, storage, and file limits.
Every provider/model lane must show FS27 billable rate and upstream cost basis.
Every 0S action should log locally and mirror to FS27 when FS27_EVENT_MIRROR_URL is configured.
CitadelDB, SkyeVault, and SkyeMail must be presented as sovereign choices, not hidden back-office experiments.
